title: IOAI 2024 Practical Round official task rubric

criteria.name: Predefined object inclusion
criteria.scoring: 1 point for each of the first five included objects; 0.25 for each additional object, capped at 7.

criteria.name: Delivery
criteria.scoring: Image is at least 1024×1024 and appropriately sized and placed in the provided frame.

criteria.name: Predefined object inclusion
criteria.scoring: 1 point for each of the first five included objects; 0.25 for each additional object, capped at 7.

levels.condition: at least 37 but shorter than 47 seconds

ordinal_criterion_scale.applies_to: Criteria marked 1–5 in the task statement

anchors.1: low-performance anchor stated for the criterion
anchors.3: middle-performance anchor stated for the criterion
anchors.5: high-performance anchor stated for the criterion

published_results_note: Official results publish a jury score and, for some ranked teams, a peer-voting score. The results page does not publish a formula combining those columns into rank.

applicability.scope: The 2024 IOAI Practical Round only, later renamed Team Challenge.
applicability.other_editions: IOAI rules state that Team Challenge scoring is task-specific and announced in each task statement.

supports: 40:60 image-to-video weight statement and 40-point task tables

limitations: The task text says the image/video weighting is 40:60 but presents two official 40-point rubrics and the local benchmark records total_points as 80. This file preserves the explicit rubric maxima and flags the inconsistency rather than inventing a reconciliation.
The official final-ranking formula involving jury and peer voting is not stated in the cited public results page.
Do not reuse these creative-media criteria for the 2025 robotics Team Challenge.
